import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] line = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int h = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);

        int[][] minheight_counts = new int[36][36];
        minheight_counts[0][0] = 1;

        for (int nodes = 1; nodes < 36; nodes++) {
            for (int minheight = 0; minheight <= nodes; minheight++) {
                for (int root_node = 1; root_node <= nodes; root_node++) {
                    int left_size = root_node - 1;
                    int right_size = nodes - root_node;
                    int minheight_minus_one = Math.max(minheight - 1, 0);
                    minheight_counts[nodes][minheight] += minheight_counts[left_size][0] * minheight_counts[right_size][0]
                        - (minheight_counts[left_size][0] - minheight_counts[left_size][minheight_minus_one])
                        * (minheight_counts[right_size][0] - minheight_counts[right_size][minheight_minus_one]);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(minheight_counts[n][h]);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
